question: Có bao nhiêu tiệm ăn ở Phường Hải Châu?
gold_sql:
SELECT count(*)::integer AS total
        FROM poi p
        WHERE p.amenity = %s
          AND ST_Contains(
            (SELECT ST_CollectionExtract(ST_MakeValid(geom), 3) FROM boundaries WHERE id = %s),
            p.geom
          )
